# Copilot Instructions for `todoy`

This repository is in early setup, so keep changes small, practical, and easy to evolve.

## General guidance

- Prefer simple, maintainable solutions over heavy scaffolding.
- Do not introduce new dependencies or tooling unless they are necessary for the requested change.
- Keep files and folders clearly named and grouped by purpose.
- Preserve any user-authored work and avoid unrelated refactors.

## When adding code

- Follow existing patterns once the codebase establishes them.
- Add only the minimum configuration needed to support the requested feature.
- Keep functions and modules focused and easy to test.
- Update relevant documentation when setup steps, commands, or behavior change.

## Quality expectations

- Reuse existing helpers and conventions instead of duplicating logic.
- Surface errors clearly rather than hiding failures.
- Add or update tests when the repository has a test setup for the affected area.
